rows.en: <operator(23040,1)><speed(2)><move(1,2,14)>Let me explain the operation<marker(1,2,14,0)> for you.<move(2,2,14)>

<operator(23040,1)><speed(2)>The <color(4)>high priest<ce()> is <move(1,4,14)>aboard a <color(4)>train<ce()><marker(11,4,15,0)> that got out of the <book(54)>Domepolis<endbook()><move(2,4,14)><picture(64,2,14,0)><refer(2,14,4,15)><marker(30,5,14,0)>, but a <book(56)>Siberian Railway<endbook()> unit is chasing it.
<operator(23040,1)><speed(2)>Our goal is to cover the <color(4)>train<ce()> until <marker(42,3,0,0)>it <marker(42,5,0,0)>escapes <marker(42,10,0,0)>the operation area.

<operator(23040,1)><speed(2)>The enemy <color(5)>pursuit force<ce()><marker(20,2,6,0)> is sure to come and stop the <color(4)>train<ce()><marker(20,3,9,0)> in <marker(20,6,9,0)>its <marker(20,1,11,0)>tracks<picture(65,2,7,0)><refer(2,7,1,11)>, so take those guys out first.
<operator(23040,1)><speed(2)>I think the <color(4)>train<ce()> will <color(6)>head for a safe route that is clear of enemies<ce()>, so don't let it go off in some weird direction.

<operator(23040,1)><speed(2)>There are also enemy <move(1,7,11)><color(5)>frontline bases<ce()><marker(26,9,2,0)><marker(26,3,3,0)><marker(26,7,8,0)><marker(26,7,11,0)> in the area.<marker(37,7,4,0)> If <danger(1)><move(2,7,11)><picture(66,30,14,0)><refer(30,14,7,11)>the <color(4)>train<ce()> heads toward one, it's in real danger, so watch out.
rows.notes: Plural bases: four type-26 markers in the source.

uncertainties.issue: "hen na houkou ni susumasenai you ni" - causative: do not let (make) the train go in a wrong direction, i.e. the player steers it by clearing routes. Rendered "don't let it go off in some weird direction".
"zensen kichi" number not marked in source; plural chosen from the four base markers. "frontline bases" is descriptive, no locked term found.
Title is "New Federation" although the pursuers are the Siberian Railway (its subordinate body); as in source.

checked_decisions: Slot 23 ruling: causative read correctly - the player must keep the train from going the wrong way by clearing routes; "don't let it go off in some weird direction" is right.
Slot 24 ruling: plural "frontline bases" is supported by the four type-26 markers; descriptive term, no locked term exists.
Slot 0 ruling: title "New Federation" kept as in source even though the pursuers are the Siberian Railway (its subordinate body per 4003060 slot 24).
Slot 20: "high priest" consistent with 4003060 and dialogue batch_01895. Command order and positions follow the source clause by clause.
Slot 22: "ashidome wo shi ni kuru hazu" -> "is sure to come and stop the train in its tracks" correct.
remaining_uncertainties: Slot 24: the number of frontline bases is an inference from the markers.
Slot 22: three type-20 markers were spread over "in its tracks"; timing only checkable in a build.
